problem.title: Pages lose focus when every element tells a different story
problem.body: A page may target several needs, bury its useful answer, repeat another URL, or leave visitors without a logical next step. Small edits made in isolation rarely resolve that mismatch.

method.title: Give every existing page a defined job
method.intro: The work starts with search intent and page purpose, then aligns the elements that help people and search engines interpret the page.

steps.title: Intent and role
steps.body: Define the primary search need, audience, conversion role, and relationship to nearby pages before recommending edits.

steps.title: Titles and headings
steps.body: Align the title, description, H1, and heading sequence with the page purpose without forcing repetitive phrasing.

steps.title: Coverage and clarity
steps.body: Identify missing answers, unclear sections, and unsupported claims within existing copy, then specify the revisions needed.

steps.title: Internal pathways
steps.body: Improve contextual links and calls to action so readers can move to the next relevant page and important URLs gain useful context.

outcome.title: A page system with less overlap and clearer intent
outcome.body: Each recommendation explains what should change, why it matters, and which existing page owns the topic. New content production remains a separate content SEO scope.
points: Defined search intent and business role per page
Titles, headings, and snippets aligned to that role
Revision notes for clarity and topic coverage
Internal links that reinforce page relationships

links.label: Resolve systems with technical SEO services

related.title: Continue with the right page scope

cta.title: Discuss the pages that need a clearer purpose
